courses.entryRequirements: 180 credits from a programme in biochemistry/chemistry, biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, cell/molecular biology, genetics, life science, medical sciences or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in biochemistry, cell biology, chemistry, genetics, and molecular biology/genetics totalling at least 30 credits. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
